control_flags.objectives: The numbered items of a subsection, only where every one must be met.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable requirements that are implemented. The Act defines no score; this percentage is an HCG measure of progress.

rules.summary: A requirement is met only when every element it lists is met.

The Act applies to a business that, in a calendar year, controls or processes personal data of at least 100,000 Virginia consumers, or of at least 25,000 consumers while deriving over 50% of gross revenue from selling personal data.
rules.quote: control or process personal data of at least 100,000 consumers

rules.summary: A consumer rights request is answered within 45 days of receipt; the period may be extended once by 45 days with notice to the consumer.
rules.quote: within 45 days of receipt of the request submitted pursuant to the methods described in subsection A.

rules.summary: Before suing, the Attorney General gives 30 days written notice; a violation cured within that period, with a written statement, is not pursued.
rules.quote: Prior to initiating any action under this chapter, the Attorney General shall provide a controller or processor 30 days

consequences.summary: The Attorney General can seek an injunction and civil penalties of up to $7,500 for each violation.
consequences.quote: civil penalties of up to $7,500 for each violation under this chapter.

glossary.definition: The Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act, Virginia's comprehensive consumer privacy law, in force since 1 January 2023.
The person that, alone or jointly with others, determines the purpose and means of processing personal data.
A person that processes personal data on behalf of a controller.

Personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, religious beliefs, health diagnosis, sexual orientation, citizenship or immigration status; genetic or biometric data used to identify a person; data of a known child; and precise geolocation data.

A documented assessment, required before targeted advertising, sale of personal data, certain profiling and processing of sensitive data, that weighs the benefits of processing against the risks to consumers.
